gaps.surface: Council meeting outcomes · no event join
gaps.notices_affected_estimate: Modern (2025+) Public Hearings notices join at 100% via the strict exact_date_body_tokens join. Remaining unmatched: pre-modern historical notices (73% strict join) and non-Council public hearings that have no Legistar event.
gaps.evidence: Authenticated edge materialization is live. Modern strict event join is 100% (59/59). Unmatched is now genuine absence (non-Council hearing or pre-modern historical), not incomplete join.

gaps.surface: Council meeting outcomes · matter without roll-call detail
gaps.notices_affected_estimate: Items listed on the agenda but not yet acted upon at materialization time. Most acted items already show an inline outcome (Approved, Passed) from EventItemActionName; per-person roll-call detail is published on the endpoint only when a roll-call vote is taken (~10% of events).
gaps.evidence: Authenticated edge materialization fetches roll-call tallies best-effort for flagged items. Voice votes and many committee approvals carry no roll-call rows on the API; those slots show the action outcome instead of a gap. Empty roll-call with no outcome is pending Council action, not a missing ingest.

gaps.surface: Council meeting outcomes · event without agenda matters
gaps.notices_affected_estimate: Modern joined events have agenda items 100% and matter-linked items 98.3%. Remaining: events whose agenda has not been published yet at materialization time.
gaps.evidence: EventItems are materialized with inline matter linkage. Empty matters is now pre-agenda timing (the agenda PDF/minutes have not posted), not an absent ingest.
